newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal firms, deposits little changed.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal firms, deposits little changed.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal against the dollar firmed this week and riyal interbank deposit rates were little changed in moderate trade focused on the swaps ahead of the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan, dealers said on Thursday.
The riyal firmed to 3.6501/03 to the dollar from 3.7504/06 to the dollar last week, they said.

Some interbank deposit rates rose 1/16 point. One-month funds were quoted at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, three months were at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent, six months were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent and one-year deposits were put at six, 5-7/8 percent.
